rust_summary: the window's game starting and stopping, and the start and end of every client tick, menus included (`native_client_started`, `native_client_stopping`, `native_client_tick_pre`, `native_client_tick_post`).
doc_summary: The window's own lifecycle, as Fabric's `ClientLifecycleEvents` and `ClientTickEvents` have it: `native_client_started()` once before the first client tick, `native_client_stopping()` once when the player quits or closes the window (before single player's server thread is told to stop), and `native_client_tick_pre()` / `native_client_tick_post()` (NeoForge's `ClientTickEvent.Pre` and `.Post`) around every client tick, on the title screen, in menus and while paused too, which `native_tick` is not. Client-side, the window only. Bundles need "hooks": @API:client_lifecycle@.
